bundle.shortDescription: Mock up an Instagram post and a printed zine side by side
bundle.longDescription: Trafika plans one Instagram post and one printed, numbered zine from the same photos: per-side borders, covers, imposition templates, serials and barcodes. Works offline; nothing is ever posted.
